_comment: P3G.2 (#22) PR-blocking gate baseline. pass_rate is (passed / (passed + failed)) among NON-xfail cases for the category, from a clean `pytest evals/ -m "not integration"` run -- see evals/conftest.py's pytest_sessionfinish hook and evals/runner/gate.py. Regenerate by running the suite and updating a category's pass_rate deliberately (in its own commit, with a reason) whenever an intentional, reviewed change lowers it -- never to silence an unexplained regression.

citation_present._note: #58: re-recorded 11 of 12 cases against the live qwen3-8b-q5 answer model (the 12th, statin-ck-myopathy-question, could not be re-recorded -- see its case file's comment -- and is unchanged from the qwen3:4b era). 6 of the 12 cases now genuinely pass (verdict verified + a real, verified guideline_chunk citation) and their xfail was removed; the other 6 remain documented xfail with an updated rationale reflecting the actual 8B-Q5 observed behavior. pass_rate is 1.0 because CategoryStats.pass_rate excludes xfailed cases from its denominator (6 passed / (6 passed + 0 failed) among the non-xfail cases) -- this baseline guards those 6 real passes from regressing, same accounting the other categories use; it does NOT mean 12/12 pass.
